text:
Sara pays $1 per day for her mobile phone.
In one week she can make 100 minutes of free calls.
All other calls are charged at 50 cents per minute.
Work out the total amount Sara pays in one week when she makes 120 minutes of calls.
$ ................................................. [3]
subject: International Mathematics
